newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $426 mln for Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $426 mln for Wednesday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Wednesday, June 3 are expected to total $426 million in 18 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $394 million in 12 sales, with a $160 million Philadelphia School District deal through Merrill Lynch & Co. topping the list. .
On the competitive side, six sales totaling $31 million are on the schedule. A $13 million Clyde Savannah CSD, N.Y., deal is the largest. .
An additional six sales totaling $222 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues Wednesday depending on market conditions.
